description: He wears a long muted blue-green crossed-front coat with dark and gold cloud-like woven trim along the collar, front opening, cuffs and hem, and restrained gold embroidery on shoulders and sleeves. A cream underlayer shows at the collar, while brown fitted inner sleeves show below the coat's wider cuffs. A blue-green and brown woven sash wraps the waist, with long fringed ties hanging down one side. Loose dark brown trousers gather into tall brown leather boots secured by crossed narrow straps. No headgear, weapons or armor are present.
